title: Get SPS Metric Top Items
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /analytics/202606/shop_performances/metrics/{metric_code}/top_items

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Returns the top products for NRR, NBFR, or AHT, or the top logistics providers for OTDR. Shop Performance Score (SPS) reflects a shop’s performance across key operational and service metrics on TikTok Shop. By integrating the read-only SPS APIs, ISVs can retrieve a shop’s score, tier, benefits, and metric benchmarks, diagnose performance gaps, and drill down to the products, logistics providers, aftersales types, orders, or chats associated with specific issues. This enables ISVs to embed actionable performance insights into their solutions, helping merchants identify problem areas faster and take targeted actions to improve shop performance. Available only for US-region shops. Use case guide: Click here

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
metric_code string Y NRR Metric code that selects the returned top-items list:
  • NRR: products with negative reviews (nrr_top_product_items).
  • NBFR: products with returns or refunds (nbfr_top_product_items).
  • OTDR: logistics providers and their on-time delivery performance (otdr_logistics_items).
  • AHT: products and their aftersales handling details (aht_aftersales_type_items). |

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
locale string N en-US BCP 47 locale code used to localize response text. If omitted, the default locale is resolved from the request context.

^^delivered_order_count int 300 Total number of delivered orders.

^^negative_order_count int 12 Number of orders with negative reviews.
^^product_id string 1729592969712207008 Product ID.
^^product_name string Wireless Headphones Product name.
^^top_review_reasons []string ["Item doesn't match description"] Top negative review reasons.

^total_count int 120 Number of items in the metric-specific list returned by this response.
